subject: Verify owner persistence of one work_item_id across distinct effect operation attempts, plus the outer Vuoro repository gate and a stale-basis owner refusal.
source_of_truth: Released Sprintctl PostgreSQL work_effect_attempt rows for attempt/stale-basis facts; Vuoro HTTP identity authorization for the wrong-repository refusal. The latter is an outer service gate, not owner-side cross-repository isolation.
backends: disposable PostgreSQL 16 container on loopback, database lease_conformance_er004, non-superuser test role
initial_state: A disposable PostgreSQL owner database is empty and marked sprintctl:disposable-integration-test.
The owner fixture creates a unique repo_id, work item, reservation, intent, release evidence and accepted intent.
The same accepted intent is eligible for the two existing provider_operation kinds: push_branch and open_pull_request.

operations.name: Open open_pull_request effect attempt for the same accepted intent
Invoke GET with repo_id set to foreign-repo; Vuoro's repo_scoped gate rejects it before registry.invoke
Change the work item release basis, then redeem the second attempt

consistency.object: work_effect_attempt and work_effect_attempt_event rows for one repo_id and intent_id

assumptions.isolation: Single disposable PostgreSQL 16 server; owner transactions run at the server's configured default isolation.
assumptions.clock: PostgreSQL owner clock; no clock-dependent edge is asserted.

invariants: The two persisted attempt IDs differ.
Both attempt rows retain the same work_item_id and same accepted intent_id.
The operation kinds are push_branch and open_pull_request; they are not provider identities.
Vuoro's repo_scoped authorization branch rejects the wrong-repository envelope with HTTP 403 before invoking the operation registry; this is not a DB-level Sprintctl repository isolation test.
Stale-basis redemption is denied with HTTP 409 effect-release-mismatch and causes no owner-row changes.
faults: Wrong-repository read request for an existing attempt.
Work-item release basis changes after two attempts are opened and before one attempt is redeemed.
oracles: owner_rows snapshots compare the fixture repo's effect-attempt, event, intent, release, work-item, run, and idempotency rows before/after the wrong-repository HTTP request and stale-basis owner refusal; only the latter reaches the owner.
The complete test_effect_attempt_http.py module must pass against the pinned published Sprintctl 0.28.1 wheel.
